name: Futanari College
source:
My name is Alex. It so happened that in the midst of my second year of study at a mechanical engineering college, our family urgently had to move to another city because of my father's death. Fortunately, there was also a college of this profile and I was promptly transferred and issued without losing the course. But the level of students, and of the technical school itself as a whole, was several times lower than that of me in my hometown.
Of course, a remote provincial town with stupid thugs instead of responsible and conscientious students like me. And on the very first day of my studies in a new place something happened that radically changed my whole life...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696200/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我叫亚历克斯。恰巧我在机械工程学院读二年级的时候，因为父亲的去世，我们全家紧急搬到了另一个城市。幸运的是，也有一所这样的大学，我很快就被转发了，没有失去课程。但学生的水平，乃至技校本身的水平，都比我家乡低了好几倍。
当然，一个偏远的省城，有愚蠢的暴徒，而不是像我这样有责任心和认真的学生。在我到一个新地方学习的第一天，发生了一些事情，彻底改变了我的整个生活……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696200/]Steam[/url]]
